title: Player Guns - On-Foot & Roof Weapons (MP Compatible)
tag_line: Shoot where you look: weapons for Walking Mode and car roofs, with BeamMP sync
author: schatz.r
message:
Player Guns puts a working gun in your hands on foot and on your car's roof. You aim with the camera and bullets go where the crosshair points, in singleplayer and BeamMP.

Seven weapons: Pistol, Uzi, Thompson, AKM, Sniper, Minigun, Bazooka. Bullets are physics objects that pop tires, dent panels, and knock cars around.

Quick start on a car: spawn the "Player Guns" config (27 vanilla cars have one) or set any roof-rack car's Roof Load slot to Player Guns Roof Mount. On foot: press F to walk, then pick a Player Guns body in the Parts Manager.

Controls: LMB fires, Q reloads, O and P switch weapons. The Player Guns Controls app rebinds everything with a clickable keyboard, mouse, and controller layout.

UI apps: Crosshair, Ammo, Controls, Debug.

Credits: AwesomeCarl & AgentY (player_weapon_2), stefan750 (UniversalWeapons).
